description: This Java class extends SimpleWikiHelper to provide enhanced functionalities for processing Wiktionary content, including formatting wiki text into HTML, retrieving random words, and managing internal links and styles for display in Android WebView.

classes.name: ExtendedWikiHelper
classes.description: A helper class that extends SimpleWikiHelper to include methods for fetching random words and formatting wiki text into HTML suitable for mobile display.

methods.name: getRandomWord
methods.description: Fetches a random word from Wiktionary API, retrying multiple times to ensure validity, excluding invalid words based on a pattern.

methods.name: formatWikiText
methods.description: Transforms raw wiki-style text into styled HTML with headers, lists, internal links, and formatting, tailored for display in WebView.
